observation.visible_scene: A serene river scene at twilight or dawn, featuring calm, reflective water. A large, leafy tree dominates the left bank, while a hillside covered in trees and dotted with houses rises on the right. A small kayak with a person is visible in the middle distance on the water.
visible_changes: The camera performs a slow, steady forward movement (dolly in) along the river.
As the camera advances, the large tree on the left appears closer and gradually shifts towards the left edge of the frame, with its canopy becoming partially cropped.
The perspective of the riverbanks and the distant houses on the right hill shifts slightly due to the change in camera position.
The reflections of the trees and sky on the water surface move and distort slightly with the camera's translation.
outside_clip_unknowns: The beginning and end of the drone flight path.
The specific direction or speed of the kayak's movement relative to the water.
What lies beyond the visible hillside on the right.
uncertain_details: Whether the kayak is actively paddling towards the camera or simply drifting.
The exact altitude of the camera above the water surface.
